notes: Netter's extracted text gives plate labels only, so drainage arrows on Plates 85-86 could not be read; corrections marked netter-inferred rely on labeled node names and their plate positions. Plate 86 tongue drainage as labeled (submental, submandibular, jugulodigastric, superior deep lateral cervical, juguloomohyoid nodes) and pharynx drainage (retropharyngeal, jugulodigastric, juguloomohyoid, superior deep lateral cervical) agree with the submental, submandibular, jugulodigastric, juguloomohyoid, retropharyngeal, palatine/lingual/pharyngeal tonsil and level I-III cards; no change needed. Palatine tonsil blood supply matches all five tonsillar branches on Plate 72 (lesser palatine, ascending pharyngeal, ascending palatine, facial, dorsal lingual). Pretracheal nodes match Plate 87 ('Pretracheal lymph nodes' below the isthmus). Thoracic duct termination at the IJV-subclavian junction is confirmed by Table 2.3 (p. 218) and Plate 195; right lymphatic duct near the IJV from apical axillary nodes on Plate 191; jugular trunk labeled on Plate 85. Netter 7e does not label the following, so those cards were left unchanged and cannot be verified against it: prelaryngeal (Delphian), paratracheal, scalene, infrahyoid nodes, tubal tonsils, surgical levels I-VII and all epithelium statements except the lingual tonsil crypts. Netter uses 'nodes' rather than 'lymph nodes' in labels and spells 'juguloomohyoid' without a hyphen; the remaining 'jugulo-omohyoid' spellings in detail text (submandibular, submental, level I, level III, lingual tonsil cards) could be harmonized if the name change is accepted. Netter's Virchow footnote applies to the supraclavicular group of either side, 'especially on the left', and says only 'malignant disease in the viscera'; the card's organ list is conventional, not Netter.
